notes: Part 6 of 7. AWAITING FOUNDER LOCK - spec authored 2026-08-12, no implementation started. IN: 6.1 (the creator sees which terms were already agreed vs what the campaign newly adds, plus an allocation summary) and 6.2 (filter brands by category and city - both values are already in the payload; only name is filterable today). DEFERRED: 6.3 open-campaign discovery/application, with reasons in 01-spec.md section 1. No migration.

audit_2026_08_12.finding_1: campaign_influencers.agreement_id is returned to the creator NOWHERE (zero references in influencer.controller.js). Part 2 one-click accept is enforced by the API and invisible in the product - the creator re-reads terms they already settled, with no sign they are closed.
audit_2026_08_12.finding_2: discoverEligibleBrands already SELECTs b.category and u.city AS brand_city but filters on business_name ILIKE alone (proposal.service.js:217-234). Both useful filters sit in the payload, unreachable.
audit_2026_08_12.finding_3: THE APPLICATION FLOW IS HALF-BUILT AND UNREACHABLE - the same shape as the dead offer join. Brand-side approve/reject handlers gated on ci.status=applied exist (campaign.controller.js:1952-2130) plus a brandInbox pending_applications counter, but NOTHING in the backend writes status=applied (all three campaign_influencers INSERT sites write invited) and there is no creator-facing browse-or-apply route. Prod: applied 0 rows; campaign_sets by mode = handpick 7, open_group 0, so the mode it serves has never been used once. It would also not work if built: Part 4 recorded that open-group joiners carry no allocation and no commission_pct, and since Part 4 having something to sell IS the discovery gate - a joiner would be contracted and unable to sell anything.

deferral_6_3: Deferred, not dropped. Reasons: creators already have two shipped routes to brands (pitches, requests) that no human has exercised on a device yet; open groups have zero production usage; open-campaign apply reverses the founder-stated model (agree first, then the brand builds) so it is a new idea rather than a completion of this program; and it cannot be done honestly without first fixing the Part 4 open-group allocation/commission leftover. Recorded with a test pinning the absence so a future half-build is a deliberate act.

release.deploy_class: production-impacting (backend/src, brand-web runtime, Mobile runtime) - explicit founder go required BEFORE the push, per feedback-push-is-the-deploy; no migration

qa_evidence.first_run_note: First run FAILED at 380/386. All six failures were in the API lane at exactly 60.0s — a timeout signature. Probing the backend showed it answering in 1.5s then 0.67s: it had spun down during the run and the probe woke it. The same six specs failed identically in Part 5 first run and cleared the same way. Classified as the documented Render cold start (reference_render_cold_start), not a defect and not a weakened test.

release.deploy_note: NOT PUSHED. Per feedback-push-is-the-deploy, pushing governed backend code IS the deploy on this repo, so the founder go is required BEFORE the push. Committed locally only. brand-web is untouched by this contract, so Vercel is not a target.

corrected_before_lock: The first draft said 6.2 ships on "web and mobile" and carried a web assertion (P1). There is NO creator-facing web surface — brand-web is the brand + admin dashboard and contains no reference to brand discovery. Removed rather than satisfied by building a page nobody asked for.

done: Backend: the creator collaboration detail now returns agreement_id, the settled terms and the date agreed (LEFT join, so a cold invite is unaffected), plus an allocation summary in words with auto_joins_new_products. Both built server-side so the two apps cannot drift and the test can assert the payload.

Backend: brand discovery gained category and city filters (both values were already in the response and unfilterable), plus a facets query built from the SAME eligibility conditions as the list, delivered on the same response so no filter that returns nothing is ever offered.

Mobile: the creator collaboration screen splits into "Already agreed with you" (with the agreed date) and "New in this campaign"; Negotiate is hidden ONLY for agreement-backed collaborations because the server already refuses it; the allocation renders in words. Discover tab gained industry + city chips that clear on re-tap.
Tests: 23 new. The summarisers are executed on real inputs rather than grepped, and one test walks every backend file to assert no application writer exists.
remaining: On-device verification — bundle-level verified only; owed at the founder walkthrough (fifth consecutive mobile release without Maestro).
